stories.title: Flintshire residents sought as volunteer police custody visitors
stories.summary: People in Flintshire are being asked to apply to become volunteer custody visitors, making unannounced checks on people held in police cells in North Wales. stories.title: Dog rescued from Dee Estuary off Thurstaston after owner gets stuck in mud

stories.title: Alun School in Mold to stay shut to pupils on Tuesday
stories.summary: Alun School in Mold will be closed to pupils again on Tuesday because the school has no gas supply. The school shut on Monday because of a fault with its central heating system. stories.title: Welsh Government publishes new National Strategy for Unpaid Carers with seven priorities
stories.summary: A new Welsh Government strategy published today sets out what councils, health boards, schools and employers are expected to do for people who look after a family member or friend without pay. stories.title: Flintshire schools are mark Odd Socks Day as Anti-Bullying Week begins
stories.summary: Many schools across Flintshire are taking part in Odd Socks Day today to start Anti-Bullying Week 2026, Flintshire County Council has said.
